additions.description: Generic Moodle Core Web Services extraction: 248 curated capability records, 239 unique function names and 12 feature gaps; legacy catalogue and Moodle 5.1/5.3/5.3.1 evidence kept distinct.
Deep planning review: keep/add/change findings, decision gates and v2.2 amendments; no implementation status is implied.
Proposed additional acceptance scenarios AT-019 through AT-030 for external idempotency, partial writes, concurrency, privacy and offline data.
Second-pass planning consistency audit, precise source counts, API/tenancy/connection gaps, tool registry requirements and closure gates.
Central catalogue of 67 test identifiers referenced by traceability and validation artifacts; none are claimed as executed.
Proposed active membership context, Moodle connection lifecycle gaps, DTO and event/error semantics.
Planning contract for external operation/step identity, outbox/inbox, cancellation and tool registry completeness.
Proposed additional acceptance tests AT-031 through AT-036; not executed.
Index of v2.3 amendments and still-open decisions.
Proposed SSRF and outbound network policy with default deny and pre-provisioned private-campus connector exception.
Updated planning dashboard with explicit P0 gate approvals/evidence matrix and v2.4 statuses.
Provisional task, tool, external-step, timeout, atomic budget-reservation and lease-fencing limits.
